name: pause-detector
title: pause-detector
description: Detect pauses and silence in audio using local dynamic thresholds. Use when you need to find natural pauses in lectures, board-writing silences, or breaks between sections. Uses local context comparison to avoid false positives from volume variation.

related_skills.name: energy-calculator
related_skills.reason: Pause detection uses pre-computed energy data; energy calculation is broader upstream capability reused for this narrower task.

related_skills.name: silence-detector
related_skills.reason: Initial-silence detection is a narrower case; pause-detector finds silence/pauses throughout audio, not just at the start.
